_comment: The pinned generation model and the sampling parameters every request is made with.
Both halves are inputs to the key a recorded call is stored under, so changing anything
here means every recorded answer misses rather than being served stale. That is the
intended behaviour and it is why there is no entry for this file in manifest.json: the
mismatch announces itself through the key, which is the mechanism that has to be correct
anyway.
`version` is the exact string sent to the provider -- a dated snapshot rather than a
floating alias, because an alias is repointed at a new model without anything in this
repository changing, which is precisely the silent substitution the pin exists to prevent.
`name` is never sent; it is the family a reader recognises.
Every parameter under `sampling` is sent explicitly on every request, including ones whose
value equals the provider's current default. Relying on a default would leave a value that
decides the output outside the key, free to move when the provider moves it.
The model is the cheapest tier that still follows the instruction to decline when the
retrieved text does not support an answer -- the behaviour the whole citation claim rests
on. Nothing has measured that yet; once there is a graded question set, this pin is what
that measurement is against, and moving it is a re-record.
name: gpt-4.1-mini

_comment: Temperature zero and a fixed seed narrow the output distribution; they do not make the
provider deterministic, and nothing here claims they do. Determinism comes from replaying
a recorded answer, not from asking nicely.
